headline: President Bush updates pay rates for certain federal government jobs, revising earlier 2003 pay adjustments.
what_it_does: This order changes the pay rates for certain federal government positions. The word "further" in the title means it revises pay rates that an earlier order had already set. No summary was provided, so the exact pay schedules and amounts are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal government employees whose pay is set by presidential pay schedules
who_it_affects.how: Their rates of pay are adjusted by this order.
